description: Defines a Playwright component class 'Form' for interacting with HTML forms in automated tests, including methods for locating inputs and buttons, checking visibility, submitting, and retrieving form data.

classes.name: Form
classes.description: A class representing a form component for Playwright testing, providing methods to interact with form elements.

methods.name: element
methods.description: Getter for the form's locator element.

methods.name: getInput
methods.description: Returns an Input object scoped within the form.

methods.name: getButton
methods.description: Returns a Button object scoped within the form.

methods.name: isVisible
methods.description: Checks if the form is visible on the page.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Submits the form by triggering the submit event.

methods.name: waitForVisible
methods.description: Waits until the form becomes visible, with optional timeout.

methods.name: getFormData
methods.description: Retrieves all form data as key-value pairs for validation or debugging.
